hierarchy.note: Higher-division grouping only, NOT the basic unit — distinct from Anglophone 'section'
Two styles: 'a)', 'b)' (alphabetic, common in ordinary laws) or '1)', '2)' (numeric, common in codes). Both map to paragraph.
Unnumbered prose paragraph; SUBSECTION used as Bluebell proxy. Post-processing may rename to alinea.

hcontainers.name: transitorio
hcontainers.note: Transitional provisions at end of law. No Bluebell keyword; use SECTION as proxy then rename in post-processing.

decreto_ejecutivo.label: Decreto Ejecutivo
decreto_ejecutivo.note: Executive decrees issued by the President and relevant Minister(s). Often reglamentos to a parent law.

constitucion.label: Constitución Política
constitucion.note: The 1949 Constitution uses TÍTULO > CAPÍTULO > ARTÍCULO. 18 Títulos, articles 1–197 continuous throughout.

frbr.number_note: Ley numbers are a single continuous sequence since 1821 (no year prefix). Store bare Ley N.° as FRBRalias. URI uses enactment year from La Gaceta publication date.

numbering.insertion_note: Inserted articles use 'bis', 'ter', 'quater', 'quinquies' suffixes (e.g., Artículo 3 bis). eId: art_3bis.

enacting_formulae.text: LA ASAMBLEA LEGISLATIVA DE LA REPÚBLICA DE COSTA RICA DECRETA:
enacting_formulae.note: Consistent formula observed across six decades (1970–2025).

enacting_formulae.text: El Presidente de la República y el Ministro de {ministry}, en uso de las atribuciones que les confieren los artículos 140, incisos 3) y 18) y 146 de la Constitución Política, decretan:
enacting_formulae.note: Template — ministry name and legal basis vary by decree.

amendments.phrasing_substitution: Refórmase el artículo [N] de la Ley [N.° NNNN], para que se lea de la siguiente manera:
amendments.phrasing_addition: Adiciónase un artículo [N bis] a la Ley [N.° NNNN], para que se lea así:
amendments.phrasing_repeal: Deróguese el artículo [N] de la Ley [N.° NNNN].
amendments.phrasing_inciso_substitution: Refórmase el inciso [a)] del artículo [N] de la Ley [N.° NNNN], para que se lea:

structuring.prompt_additions: Costa Rica uses ARTICLE (not SECTION) as the basic unit. CHAPTER, TITLE, and BOOK are higher divisions above ARTICLE. SECTION is also a higher division (never the basic unit). Inciso subdivisions within articles use PARAGRAPH keyword. Two inciso numbering styles exist: alphabetic (a), b), c)) and numeric (1), 2), 3)) — detect from document. Transitorios at the end of laws use SECTION as a proxy keyword with heading 'Transitorio N'. The enacting formula is 'LA ASAMBLEA LEGISLATIVA DE LA REPÚBLICA DE COSTA RICA DECRETA:' and goes in the PREAMBLE block.

supranational_memberships.note: Sistema de la Integración Centroamericana. SICA instruments require domestic ratification and publication in La Gaceta.
OAS conventions ratified by the Asamblea Legislativa. Inter-American Court of Human Rights (Corte IDH) is based in San José; binding judgments operate through constitutional deference.

display.note: Article headings in Costa Rican laws appear inline after the article number (e.g., 'Artículo 1.- Objeto y ámbito de aplicación.') using a dash separator, not as marginal notes.

validation.note: Public reference profile; synthetic XML controls do not certify corpus coverage.
